## Description {#details}

<p>This analysis create <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/machinefunction">MachineFunction</a> for given <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/function">Function</a>.</p>


<p>To release the <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/machinefunction">MachineFunction</a>, users should invalidate it explicitly.</p>
